title: NSYNC’s Joey Fatone Exposes Toxic Side of Boy Band Business in New Doc: “Fans Have Only Heard Some Stories”
summary: Fatone executive produced the new ID series 'Boy Band Confidential,' which featured interviews with Lance Bass, AJ McLean, Wanya Morris and Shawn Stockman, among others. "It was very therapeutic for them," Fatone tells The Hollywood Reporter of the musicians speaking out.
